grevlimid.summary: Zydus sold generic Revlimid (lenalidomide) in the US under a volume-limited settlement from Mar-2022; volume limits ended at end-Jan-2026, when unlimited generic entry was allowed. Zydus said Q2FY26 sales were 'significantly' lower than Q1, Q3FY26 was 'a very small part' and Q4FY26 nil ('we have sort of completed our business ... FY26 on Lenalidomide'). The company never disclosed the product's sales; JM Financial estimates gRevlimid and Mirabegron together at ~36% of US sales (May-2026) and PL said Revlimid and Myrbetriq contributed over 45% of FY25 EPS.

timeline.event: Ramanbhai B. Patel co-founds Cadila Laboratories in Ahmedabad.
Cadila splits; the Patel family's business is incorporated as Cadila Healthcare (now Zydus Lifesciences).
Buys Sentynl Therapeutics (US), later its rare-disease arm.
Zydus Wellness buys Heinz India (Complan, Glucon-D, Nycil): the bulk of today's Rs4,966 cr consumer goodwill.
Sells the animal-health business (gain shown in FY22 profit); renamed Zydus Lifesciences; generic Revlimid launched in the US under a volume-limited settlement (Mar-2022).
Buyback of 11.5 mn shares at Rs650 (Rs750 cr).
Buys LiqMeds (UK oral liquids) for GBP68 mn plus earn-outs.
Buyback of 6.0 mn shares at Rs1,005 (Rs600 cr).
Completes 85.6% of Amplitude Surgical (100% by Oct-2025); MedTech becomes a reported segment.
Zydus Wellness buys Comfort Click (UK) for GBP239 mn.
Completes the Agenus California biologics plants (Zylidac Bio); gRevlimid sales end with the end of volume limits.
Settles Mirabegron litigation with Astellas: US$45 mn one-off plus a US$75 mn prepaid licence.
Rs1,100 cr buyback at Rs1,260; completes Assertio (US$166.4 mn); files the Saroglitazar NDA (priority review).
